# F4: Fit and finish, goal-history

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/4-goal-history.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

fit and finish, goal-history (per-area reports, 4 Nov). The goal page ([Goal]), the History layout ([Hist]) and the check-in step's chart ([Check-in 3]).

## Where it looks

- 1280 × 800, as rhea, at `/goals/ns-lead`
- 390 × 844, as rhea, at `/goals/ns-lead`, on a touch screen
- 360 × 740, as daniel, at `/goals/lead-mq`, on a touch screen
- 1440 × 900, as amara, at `/goals/env-search`
- 1280 × 800, as tariq, at `/goals/lead-review`
- 390 × 844, as mateo, at `/check-in/mttr-pir`, on a touch screen
- 1280 × 800, as mateo, at `/check-in/mttr-pir`
- 1280 × 800, as amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history`
- 768 × 1024, as amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history`, on a touch screen
- 1440 × 700, as amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly`
- 1280 × 800, as amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly&weeks=year`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
